date_note: Date of the Meduza and Mediazona analysis; Mediazona says the hackers announced the breach on 1 November and passed data to journalists on 8 November. Rosstat's own statement was not found.
title: Hackers say they breached Rosstat; leaked civil-registry data analysed by Meduza and Mediazona
summary: Meduza says the groups Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow broke into Rosstat's electronic document system and obtained the agency's data archive, which they gave to journalists. Meduza and Mediazona analysed the data and say it shows registered deaths of Russian servicemen up to the end of September 2026. Both outlets say the data is genuine. Rosstat's response was not found.
plain: Hackers say they broke into Russia's statistics agency Rosstat and gave its data to journalists, who say it shows registered Russian military deaths up to the end of September 2026.
exec: A breach of a Russian state agency's records was used by journalists to estimate war deaths; the outlets say the data is genuine.

evidence.quote: К концу сентября 2026 года на войне с Украиной погибли как минимум 490 тысяч российских военных.

validation.note: Meduza and Mediazona published a joint analysis of the same leaked data and WP relays it; no Rosstat statement or independent confirmation of the breach was read.
